notes.title: v[1.019] Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your feedback and support.
Here are the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

1) New Building: Transfer Center
Transfer Center is a building where you can request extra penguins for your settlement and also send your penguins to the other settlements in the kingdom.
If you send your penguins, you get temporary reputation points.
If you request penguins, you get temporary penalty reputation points.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/31b4265083d7a46ad5fef3a7f1e0755d957bd310.jpg

Buildings Menu > Technology & Defense > Transfer Center

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/f2c78db11368edd02ba0ad9f525a5a8ad6b8302e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/195c1377a0dd8511bab6efb21bb6497f84072ae0.jpg

2) More Penguins at the Start
Relax Mode -> 15 penguins
Normal difficulty -> 13 penguins
Hard difficulty -> 10 penguins
Survival difficulty ->  8 penguins
One more penguin for all difficulty options is added to the start of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/aa6458abc1b153470578815e3098f10bc99064cb.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/86d62292e343931aa57cc35074e4a920b7ed61dd.jpg

3) Fewer Thief Seals
The total amount of thief seals in a seal group is decreased.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/8da3b4509a86462ea2f6c45fce73759b59f4ea67.jpg

4) Bar Progress Speed
Extra information about the fun and spirituality buildings is added.
This number can be used to understand which building fills the fun/spirituality bar faster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/30742482efcb36853b5bcb7b55202b176248aab6.jpg

5) Defense Towers Specs
Attack power information is added to the defense towers.
(Defense against killer whales and thief seals)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/b4afe87eba8a8497166721e0c0d4b538235af6b3.jpg

6) Arrows - Tutorials
More noticeable arrows are added to the tutorials.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/0240a8dd925a1018913d84753366dd1df73582a8.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/abe8c7b945e7c8e6735fda8be8eb04d96d59092e.jpg

7) Decoration Interaction Area
Circles of the decorations' ranges are redesigned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/27202bb91343d24ae78c03c76860c0623a303e66.jpg

8) Remove a Penguin from the Current Job
You can remove a penguin from the current job on the penguin widget.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/1b2f1742ce6c8e06840bcc8fd79f679d443c0fb9.jpg

9) Menu UI Redesigned
Reputation Menu, Badge Menu, Profile Menu, Science Menu, and Help Menu are redesigned

Reputation Menu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/bf94e8d10be6f581033267f940036ff95fbd3e16.jpg

Badge Menu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/cc20b9bcf2486f59eeb54cfb9996560b2e8550ca.jpg

Profile Menu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/094a93c4926b4905535418d63594da569c5c544e.jpg

Science Menu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/2f52524c2705d3fff33b4d17c46e9e326c69ba31.jpg


10) Kids House and Kids Villa - Capacity Increased
The capacity of the Kids House and Kids Villa are increased.
Five child penguins can live in a Kids House now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/80213e8723bcc95de8e6a475c7be6e2d0439b112.jpg

11) New Building Widgets
The building widgets are redesigned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/954d67c91e94c449ef67b2959405f6615efbad2a.jpg

12) Building SFX
Building-click sounds are added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/9826f022b55b56399b19492932d476c235487a9a.jpg

13) Save & Load Game Menu
Save & Load Game Menu is redesigned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/f33c57b109b7443bdfbe0590bf89e518648a3f17.jpg

14) Resolutions
Resolution issue is fixed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/00cd292c776e38d3d562782403e5d83bc7cdf5c9.jpg



Please let us know about your feedback and suggestions.
We'll continue to update the game based on your feedback.

All the best
Turquoise Revival Games

notes.title: v[1.011] Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your feedback and support.
Here are the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

1) New Language: Korean

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/6188faa09e4e581021cd389126af98fd5d7038ad.png

2) Font Size Increased

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/64ee36538f802e405fc1828b6fd12fec56103e65.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/87428bbd513b50c08e79ea013ec83e65f82c8d2a.jpg

3) New Building: Stone Extractor
(This building can be unlocked in the full game)
Stone Extractor extracts stones from the bottom of the ocean.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/56c6b0aa11bd12bb44988d0202d37683a41252b5.jpg

4) More Penguins at the Start
Two more penguins for Relax Mode and Normal Mode and one penguin for Hard and Survival Mode are added to the start of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/94e233ef236dda1ee928fed07f28d64b8c2a2408.jpg

5) Ice Spear Production
Ice Spear Tower produces two ice spears from one snow block.
Ice Spear Tower limit by default is increased to 14.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/8eff5e542ed9f46665e33049532dc6b66b9cfca4.jpg

6) Killer Whale Difficulty Setting
This setting affects the visit frequencies of killer whales and their total health.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/ed6b9ff3c86551f65603d59555758ffaa73aa469.jpg

7) Thief Seals Difficulty Setting
This setting affects the total health and amount of thief seals visiting your settlement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/db15325d2e9740be247f0e0f65ef788552212120.jpg

8) Productivity Widget
The productivity widget on top of the building is redesigned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/e1cf509e54a00e30bc6313da40834f93b54d1ebc.jpg

9) Task Unlock Type (Science Points)
Required science points can be seen on the task widget.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/69f59a1d4c7e26037153ee68fe573bf1dc4b6152.jpg

10) Assign Worker
Assign worker hover info is fixed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/abca8fc42ff3926365c502586ca0daa07f9809a1.jpg

11) Ocean Garbage Collector
The particle location of the building is fixed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/69882060654cf25a93a86c52ffa98231902fd7b4.jpg

12) Penguin Productivity
Penguin productivity percentage can always be seen on worker widgets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/184a8d359bbdad152000d4da4526b21e63997654.jpg

13) New Loading Screen

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/7c53938ec247b1fff88ff082728432c87ffba57e.jpg

14) Annual Objectives
This feature is for the full version of the game. Annual objectives are received at the end of the year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/0695915b7ad9ffbecdaee4900b0de44f1aedd3f0.jpg

15) Settlement Level Icon
The current settlement level icon is shown on the HUD-Profile Menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/55e0644294565d1d0587932d9a3102d26c12c66a.jpg

Other fixes and improvements:
* Fixed some translations 
* Fixed the help request widget - game paused
* Fixed the "All penguins died" situation - New penguins join your settlement if all your penguins die.

Older Savegames are not compatible with this version.

Please let us know about your feedback and suggestions.
We'll continue to update the game based on your feedback.

All the best
Turquoise Revival Games
